data.description: Cows are livestock you keep for [milk](/items/milk), [dung](/items/dung) and breeding, found wild in temperate and tundra. A cow becomes yours when you buy one or when it eats from your trough, and only cows you own make milk, drop dung and breed. Stay near one to build trust: after 5 minutes you can lead it, and the lead breaks beyond 15m. They graze grass, drink fresh water and eat any food from a trough, and an owned cow stores up to 3 milkings. Cow genetics cover four genes: dung, yield, fertility and hardiness.
